## Definition

A sequence $\{w_t\}$ is **white noise** with variance $\sigma^2$ if:


$$\mathbb{E}[w_t] = 0, \quad \text{Var}(w_t) = \sigma^2, \quad \text{Cov}(w_s, w_t) = 0 \; (s \neq t)$$


If the joint distribution is Gaussian, we call it **Gaussian white noise**.

:::callout-note
White noise is *uncorrelated*, not necessarily independent—unless Gaussian.
:::

## Properties

- Weakly stationary  
- Flat autocorrelation function (ACF)  
- Building block for many time series models  

## Python example

```python
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

w = np.random.normal(0, 1, 500)
plt.plot(w)
plt.title("White Noise")
plt.show()
```
